Third-Party Notices
===================

Bundled third-party code:

1. python-qrcode
   Purpose: encode the Weibo Passport scan URL as a QR matrix.
   License:
   THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/python-qrcode_LICENSE.txt

The application does not download or execute dataabc/weibo-crawler at runtime,
and the weibo-crawler source is not bundled under weibo_archive/.

Endpoint compatibility work refers to publicly observable Weibo mobile behavior
and field/endpoint usage documented by open-source projects. The network client,
parser, models, task orchestration, and exporter in this project are independently
implemented.

Weibo web and mobile endpoints are not stable public APIs controlled by this
project and may change. Parser contract tests are therefore kept separate from
Markdown golden tests so endpoint compatibility changes do not silently alter
the archive format.
